targetText:
By the critique of imperialism, in the broad sense of the term,
 we mean the attitude of the different classes of society
summary: Different social classes view imperialism differently: capitalists defend it, middle-class reformists want to soften it, and workers must abolish it.
context: Lenin distinguishes revolutionary Marxist analysis from reformist and pacifist critiques.

targetText: Bourgeois scholars and publicists usually come out in defence
summary: Capitalist intellectuals defend imperialism by disguising its total economic control behind reformist and pacifist slogans.
context: Bourgeois pacifism distracts working people from the structural economic roots of war.

summary: Certain socialist leaders betrayed working-class internationalism by supporting their own nation's imperialist war effort.
context: Social-imperialists were socialists in words but imperialists in deeds during WWI.
